definitions.gloss: quickly; swiftly; in one smooth motion
definitions.explanation: Describes a quick, smooth action performed without hesitation.
Describes doing something in a quick, light manner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さっと⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さっと⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
さっと⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}した→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ。
examples.english: I just skimmed through it quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さっと⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{止|や}んだ→止む：01153_yamu⟧。
examples.english: It rained briefly and stopped right away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さっと⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。

notes:
さっと describes quick, smooth, effortless action — done in one clean motion without hesitation or fuss.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- さっと⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to skim through quickly
- さっと⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to finish up quickly
- さっと⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧: to stir-fry briefly
- さっと⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧: to glance through
- さっと⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up quickly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぱっと→ぱっと：05356_patto⟧: suddenly, in a flash (more abrupt, often visual — ぱっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{明|あか}るくなる→明るい：00616_akarui⟧)
- ⟦すっと→すっと：01804_sutto⟧: smoothly, quietly (gentler, more subtle movement)
- ⟦さっさと→さっさと：05795_sassato⟧: briskly, without delay (implies impatience or efficiency; often used as a command)

USAGE:
さっと often implies a light, surface-level action: さっと⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (quick rinse, not a thorough wash), さっと⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (skim, not a careful read). In cooking, さっと⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ means to blanch briefly.
